interface.shortDescription: Work in Atoi from the agent you are already in
interface.longDescription: Atoi brings its governed verbs into Codex: Projects and Workspaces, the Workspace Thread, Tasks with change sets and proof, search, Inbox decisions, Ideas, plans, automations, channels, skills, settings, usage, and a readiness check. Consequential actions raise the same approval card a person gets, and every action leaves a receipt you can read back in Atoi.
